interpretation: Apply existing operational quality targets separately to each stage and geometry as descriptive development references, not new final GO gates. A room-only failure warrants a targeted correction before claiming general indoor utility. Do not pool stages to hide a failure. Group all variations/counts of an episode in the same partition.
rendering: Use the same spherical image-source direct path for every stage, max_order=0 for direct control. Match content, room dimensions, off-center array pose, source reference directions and noise realization across stages. Source distance is 1.5 m; planar sources stay in the array plane. Normalize actual received scored-window levels and SNR. Report measured Schroeder T20 extrapolation and direct/reflected RIR energy ratio separately from target RT60. Uniform absorption and empty shoebox remain approximations.
assets: Reuse the 16 consumed reference speakers for development diagnosis; reserve new speakers and episode seeds for independent confirmation after any correction. These tests alone do not expand qualification.
